## Description

Please include a summary of the change, the problem solved, and the architectural context.

Fixes # (issue reference)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor / Code Quality (improvement of existing logic without functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test coverage expansion

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

- [ ] **Unit Tests**: Run `npm run test` in frontend/backend.
- [ ] **Manual Verification**: Visual UI, API response, browser console verification.
- [ ] **Integration/Build**: Verified production build using `npm run build`.

## Pre-submission Checklist

- [ ] My code aligns with the repository's coding guidelines (e.g. state management rules, CSS patterns).
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved any linting errors.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (like README or BRANCH_WORKFLOW) if my changes introduced new dependencies or CLI scripts.
- [ ] My changes generate no new TypeScript compilation warnings or console spams.
